priceSnapshot.note: The reclaim was confirmed and then handed straight back. Endday set two explicit tests for this session and both of them passed. The 4H bar that closed at 04:00Z settled 63,831.5, which is 88.4 points ABOVE the 4H EMA200 at 63,743.09, and the 4H MACD histogram narrowed from -154.96 to -127.94. By the criteria endday published five hours ago, the intermediate structure is repairing and the bear-trap read was correct. The problem is what price did with the confirmation: nothing. Since the endday mark at 63,826.4 the tape has produced a run of descending hourly highs - 63,923.2, then 63,892.1, then 63,873.0, then 63,844.2, then 63,800.0 - and the whole 88.4-point cushion above the 4H EMA200 has been given back. At 63,736.7 price is 6.4 points BELOW that moving average, which means the in-progress 4H bar opened at 04:00Z is currently tracking to settle back underneath the level the previous bar just reclaimed. That bar settles at 08:00Z, forty-one minutes after this report is stamped, and it is the single most important print in the morning session's inbox. Open interest says nobody is pressing either side: 2,046,490,874 against the endday read of 2,046,252,459 is +0.01%, statistically flat, so the short covering that powered the 588.8-point recovery has stopped and no fresh leverage has replaced it. The 24-hour realized liquidation tape remains overwhelmingly one-directional - $5,797,383 of longs against $828,738 of shorts, a 7.0x ratio - and the long/short account ratio has only eased from 1.81 to 1.77. A book that crowded, on a tape that has been flushing longs seven-to-one, sitting exactly on the level that defines the structure, is a coin balanced on its edge. July CPI at 12:30Z is outside this report's window - it lands forty minutes after the morning session publishes - so the next 4.5 hours are a pre-print vacuum, and the highest-probability path through a vacuum is chop.

reduceIf.confirmation: TWO settled 1H closes below $63,500, or one close below plus a failure to reclaim it on the very next bar. The level is carried forward from endday but the confirmation is deliberately widened, and the reason is the lesson this desk wrote to its own ledger last night: a reduce line that sits INSIDE a liquidation cluster measures a sweep, not a trend, and its base rate for reversing immediately is high. 63,500 is the $1,735,801 realized-liquidation shelf, still the largest single cluster on the 24-hour tape, and price already traded clean through it in both directions during last night's sweep. A single close beneath it is exactly what a pre-CPI liquidity hunt produces. Requiring the second close is the difference between selling the sweep and selling the break.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above $63,930 WITH open interest FALLING across the same bar. Carried forward unchanged from endday, including the deliberate inversion on open interest, because the trigger has not been touched: the best close since the endday mark is 63,831.5 and the best high is 63,923.2, which came within 6.8 points and failed. The inversion matters more now than when it was written - with the account ratio at 1.77 an advance on RISING open interest would be retail adding to an already crowded long book into a CPI print, which is the setup for the cascade, not the breakout.

decisionBox.changed: Position moves from ADD to HOLD, and the move is deliberate rather than defensive. Three things argue against spending anything here. First, endday left 48.89 USDT dry ON PURPOSE and said so explicitly in its hand-off: the cash is reserved for the CPI reaction, not the anticipation. This desk has been whipsawed twice in a single day already - ADD at 64,397.6, REDUCE at 63,586.3 - and both times the error was acting into a vacuum rather than a signal. Second, the wallet is already positioned for the thesis it believes: 0.00232786 BTC of spot, roughly 75% of equity, expressing exactly the reclaim that endday's two tests just confirmed. There is nothing to add that the book does not already say. Third, the invalidation is 499.1 points below spot and the reduce line is 236.7 below, so there is no risk-management case for trimming either. The resting stop at 63,380 is carried forward unchanged - below the $820,395 shelf at 63,400 and 142.4 points above the swept low - because the magnet field below is still 3.6x the size of the field above and a stop is the only protection that works while nobody is watching.

liquidityMagnet.note: Measured, not estimated. Summed by side of spot, the shelves below carry $4,894,904 and the shelves above carry $1,355,131 - the downside field is 3.6x the upside field. That asymmetry is the single clearest number in this report and it has not changed in direction for three sessions. It is reinforced by the long/short split of the same tape: $5,797,383 of longs liquidated against $828,738 of shorts over 24 hours, a 7.0x ratio, which says the market has been repeatedly reaching down to take long stops rather than up to take short stops. Caveat worth stating plainly - this is REALIZED liquidation data, so it maps where leverage has already been flushed, not resting orders. Those levels have behaved as magnets on this tape, but they are a rear-view mirror with a good track record, not a forward order book.

etfFlows.note: The missing number arrived and it went the other way. Endday published Farside's 11 August row as a preliminary net OUTFLOW of $42.4m with IBIT still showing an unreported dash, and warned explicitly against modelling the missing piece. IBIT has now reported +$50.2m, which flips the completed 11 August row to a net INFLOW of $7.8m - FBTC -$4.1m, ARKB -$11.5m, EZBC -$16.5m, HODL -$10.3m, IBIT +$50.2m, everything else flat. This is the second consecutive session where the discipline of refusing to model IBIT was correct in process, and the first where refusing to model it avoided an error in the BEARISH direction: yesterday a preliminary -$91.0m resolved worse to -$144.6m, today a preliminary -$42.4m resolved better to +$7.8m. The transferable point is that the preliminary figure carries no directional information at all, not that it is biased one way. On the flows themselves: +$7.8m after 10 August's completed -$144.6m is a single day of marginal inflow, which is a stabilisation rather than a bid. The five-day run of 3-7 August that delivered +$865.3m has not resumed.

divergences.note: The mechanism behind last night's reversal, recorded because it worked and because it has now been spent. The 16:00Z bar bottomed at 63,460.4 with RSI at 30.05; two hours later the 19:00Z bar bottomed 222.8 points LOWER at 63,237.6 with RSI 5.83 points HIGHER at 35.88. Price made the lower low, momentum refused to confirm it, and the 588.8-point recovery began on the very next bar. This is the cleanest textbook divergence to appear on this tape in weeks and it validates endday's bear-trap framing. It is logged as resolved, not active - the signal has already paid out and must not be counted a second time as a reason to be long from here.

calibration.note: Endday's two published lines both survived the window and neither fired. The reduce at 63,500 was never threatened on a settled basis - the lowest 1H close since was 63,589.4 and the lowest wick 63,527.3, so the shelf held on every approach. The add at 63,930 missed by 6.8 points, with the 02:00Z bar printing a 63,923.2 high and closing 63,756.0, so the price half never cleared even though the open-interest half would have. priorReduceFired is therefore false. actingHelped is marked false, narrowly and on a technicality worth stating: endday's 18 USDT spot buy at 63,826.4 marks at 63,736.7 for -89.7 points, or -0.14% on the tranche, which is about -$0.025 in absolute terms. The process was right - it set two falsifiable tests, both passed, and it sized the entry at roughly a third of available cash. The outcome is trivially negative so far because price has simply not moved. This is the third consecutive session where a correct process has produced a flat-to-slightly-negative outcome, which is the expected signature of trading a range, not evidence that the process is broken.
